newsitem.title: INDIA: India copper climbs as nickel loses ground.
newsitem.headline: India copper climbs as nickel loses ground.

text.p: Copper prices extended losses while nickel lost the gained ground on the local market on Tuesday, as other base metals moved in a narrow range to finish steady, dealers said.

Copper prices dropped further by 50 rupees at 13,200 rupees per quintal on fresh selling influenced by the weak trend in the world market. Sluggish local buying also aided the subdued sentiment. Copper was down by 75 rupees per quintal on Monday after losing 175 rupees during last week.
Nickel prices dropped by 200 rupees at 34,100 rupees per quintal as a setback in the world market prompted profit-taking. Nickel was up by 500 rupees last week.
Lead was quiet at 4,200 rupees as was zinc at 8,400 rupees and tin at 29,200 rupees per quintal amid limited activity.
Aluminium was steady at 7,800 rupees per quintal but the undercurrent was firm on an upsurge in the world market.
"Aluminium prices in the world market have risen to their highest in 21 months and local producers may hike prices," one broker said.
